name: Caddy
description: Shows the sites a Caddy 2 web server publishes as a reverse proxy: domains, the upstream address and port, redirects, and whether Caddy makes the HTTPS certificate itself. Netlens ties every site to the device or container behind it, keeps an HTTPS check per site and can give the domains a DNS name. Read-only: it only reads Caddy's admin API (GET /config/). Caddy's admin API has no password: it must only be reachable from a network you trust.
author: Netlens

releases.changelog: First release. Needs Netlens 0.3.157 or newer.
